value.lines: list of {"category": str, "amount_cents": int} (line totals, quantity already applied)
value.customer: None (unknown customer -> 0% tax, no discount) or object/dict with region: str and discount_pct: number (percent, default 0)
value.result: dict {taxable_cents: int, discount_pct, tax_pct, tax_cents: int}; tax_cents rounded half-up to the cent
